description: Run a ComOS library prompt (CO 614). Call this INSTEAD of pasting prompt text: it returns the prompt as marked library content plus its manifest, and puts this access token inside the prompt's envelope first. Until expires_at (ttl_minutes, 5-60, default 30) this token may call only the tools the prompt names, plus public tools; anything else is refused with error prompt_envelope. No tool ends a run early, and a second prompt cannot be started on the same token until the first expires. Anonymous callers get the text and envelope:null. Refuses not_found, withheld (sold or runtime-source), revoked, lint_failed. Find ids with introspection_prompt_library. Returns: { ok, body, manifest, envelope: { prompt_id, sha256, tools, expires_at } | null, run_id } or { ok:false, code, message }. Example: call federation_prompt_run with arguments {}.

id.description: The library id of the prompt, e.g. "candidate-013". From introspection_prompt_library.

ttl_minutes.description: How long the run lasts, 5 to 60 minutes. Default 30.

name: federation_prompt_run
